notes.title: Ready, Steady, Ship! is coming on April 19th! - Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33894005/c2ecf2a2b95d275ab7b6855d1e7db616552f4d8f.png
Tired of renovating houses? Ready for a New Adventure? 

Our friends have you covered with Ready, Steady, Ship!, launching on April 19th! Your mission? Keep the goods flowing out of the factory like a well-oiled machine. Armed with an array of tools and equipment, you’ll assemble conveyor belts amidst the chaos, tackling ever-mounting challenges.

[previewyoutube=bI5lHvt1JwE;full][/previewyoutube]

From forklifts to cranes, springboard conveyor belts to packing foam dispensers, you’ll have an arsenal at your disposal to ensure those packages glide smoothly out of the factory. Put on your thinking hard hats and get those gears turning!

And here’s the twist: Team up with a fellow conveyor enthusiast for maximum chaos! Grab a friend, communicate, and juggle tasks frantically. Remember, teamwork makes the conveyor belt dream work.

P.S. No forklift driving license needed—just a passion for organized chaos! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Spread the word, toss a wishlist and a follow!
Follow the dev behind Ready, Steady, Ship! for more info: Twitter

Don't forget about our friends at Untold Tales
